name: Game speed buttons
author: Project Sunburn
description: Adds three buttons in front of the date: ▶ normal speed, ▶▶ twice as fast, ▶▶▶ five times as fast. Days, guests and building work all run faster, like on a faster PC.
description_de: Fügt vor dem Datum drei Tasten hinzu: ▶ normales Tempo, ▶▶ doppelt so schnell, ▶▶▶ fünfmal so schnell. Tage, Gäste und Bauarbeiten laufen schneller, wie auf einem schnelleren PC.
